recommendation_summary: Set up one free healthchecks.io dead man's switch that expects a daily ping, and add a single ping line at the end of `nightly-sync` that fires after a successful run, so a missed ping triggers an email.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to find out within a day when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: The central log, the Docker stack, and the Synology. A log you won't read would not have caught last week's outage, because a job that crashes at startup never sends anything.
labels.Bottleneck: The only signal is a success email, and you can't notice an email that never arrives.
labels.Checked myself: Only what you've told me. I haven't seen the script, the crontab, or `edna`.

note: The reply puts all four record lines before a single hosted heartbeat alert, and it explicitly drops the Synology, Docker and central-log stack.
